definitions.relative_errors: Percent. Sum absolute errors divided by sum absolute target per structure, then arithmetic mean across structures.
definitions.paw: Only native L=0,1,2 slots. Directional uses L=1 and L=2 together with their own denominator.
definitions.sacd: POTCAR-reconstructed atomic superposition cached for the Eden run, compared with the original DeepDFT-NMC target.
definitions.element_mean: Per-element scalar PAW coefficients averaged over training atoms; higher angular orders use zero.
definitions.timing: RTX 5060 Ti, steady-state seconds per structure. Mean of 50 per-structure medians, excluding I/O and setup.
